title: Research model calls count against whoever started the run, carry the tokens the provider reported, never touch the spending cap key, and show as their own block on beta usage
steps: S1: turn provider usage into a token snapshot, with and without reported usage, and for a partial batch.
S2: settle a model charge with a payer, a purpose and tokens; settle one whose answer had no usage; write zero-filled or inconsistent snapshots and an unknown payer.
S3: an account creates a place run, another joins it; a stopped run is started again by someone else; a restart with no known starter.
S4: a public /find run and a campaign run.
S5: GET /api/ops/usage over a window with research charges from customers and staff.
expect: S1: reasoning stays inside completion; no usage is NULL, never zero; a partial batch says how many calls were measured.
S2: payer, purpose and tokens are kept and account_id is untouched; tokens stay NULL; the database refuses the bad rows.
S3: the creator pays and the joiner does not; whoever started it again pays; the payer already recorded is kept.
S4: the public bucket for /find; no person for a campaign.
S5: a research block of its own, staff left out of the customers view, chat figures untouched.
fence: modelTokens' NULL-not-zero snapshot, the ledger's payer columns kept apart from account_id, the tokens/payer check constraints, joinPlace's starter stamp, the research block of /api/ops/usage

tests: provider usage becomes one snapshot; reasoning stays inside completion
no usage reported is NULL, never zero; a partial batch says how many calls were measured
a model charge keeps its payer, purpose and reported tokens, and never touches account_id
an answer without usage leaves tokens NULL; a public run has no account
the database refuses zero-filled or inconsistent token snapshots and unknown payers
the account that created the run pays; one who joins it later does not
a stopped run started again is paid by whoever started it again
a restart with no known starter keeps the payer already recorded
a public /find run is the public bucket; a campaign run has no person
GET /api/ops/usage: research model calls are a block of their own, staff left out, chat figures untouched
